messages:
diego (sec): spotted a public paste on pastebin with a blob labeled 'wrapped token'. looks like either vault transit or aws-kms ciphertext. low confidence. dropping here.
lina (cloud): paste link? redaction ok. Can you include the header of the blob (prefix)?
diego (sec): prefix: `vault:transit:v2:...` so leaning Vault-transit but could be our migration tool's envelope format.
harper (sre): if transit was used, check vault audit for `transit/decrypt` around 2026-03-22T09:12Z. also check our backup snapshots for any exported ciphertexts.
kms-watchdog: kms-alert: suspicious external paste detected matching key alias projects/our-prod/locations/global/keyRings/partner/cryptoKeys/sync-key (heuristic match) at 2026-03-22T09:12:05Z
sam (eng): wait that alias looks like our old partner sync key. we retired it last year but left a legacy rewrap path. could be a repo or backup copy.
lina (cloud): immediate containment: 1) remove partner's ingress rule on lb 2) disable legacy rewrap job in cron 3) rotate any SA keys that have 'sync-key' access. i'll take 1+2.
diego (sec): i'll open a containment JIRA and ping legal/cust-safety. also need to decide whether to mark this as P1 or P2. given public paste + potential key material, i'm leaning P1.
harper (sre): P1 accepted. checklist: - snapshot vault audit logs for 72h - revoke any non-ephemeral creds tied to partner - search backups/archives for matching ciphertext - freeze CI artifacts referencing the alias
sam (eng): search snippet i'm running now: `git grep -n "sync-key" --archival` across buckets and repos; will post results.

sam (eng): snippet results: infra/legacy/backup/hook-config.json contains `kms_key_alias: projects/our-prod/.../sync-key` (line 42) — flagging.
lina (cloud): ok pull that config out of prod, rotate key, re-encrypt backups with new key. i'm spinning up a replacement key ring now.

vault-bot: vault-audit: found 3 decrypt ops for transit/sync at 2026-03-22T09:11:58Z, 09:12:03Z, 09:12:07Z (request_ids redacted)
diego (sec): can we map the principal for those requests? need to know if they were internal service tokens or external.
harper (sre): I'll query the audit logs: `jq '.auth' < vault_audit_chunk.json | jq .client_token` and map to issuer. also check GCP access logs for serviceAccount:thirdparty-sync@our-prod.iam.gserviceaccount.com

kms-watchdog: gcp-kms-log: 2 accesses to cryptoKeyVersions/1 at 2026-03-22T09:12:03Z from serviceAccount:thirdparty-sync@partner-project.iam.gserviceaccount.com
lina (cloud): partner-side SA appearing. partner claims they rotated but their SA still exists in our IAM allowlist. we should revoke their allowlist entry and create ephemeral grant flow.
diego (sec): RBAC rollback: revert the allowlist rule change from yesterday that added wildcard audience. set strict audience to `partner-proxy` only. Can infra roll that back and add canary test?
lina (cloud): i'll rollback the allowlist and deploy a canary policy for 48h. also adding a policy to require `x-goog-cloud-resource-prefix` in tokens.
harper (sre): rewrap/rotate plan: - create new key version on KMS (or new key) - re-encrypt any stored blobs with new key - revoke old key access and disable for crypto operations - rotate SA credentials used for backups
sam (eng): command for KMS log check: `gcloud logging read "protoPayload.serviceName=\"cloudkms.googleapis.com\" AND timestamp>\"2026-03-22T08:50:00Z\"" --project=our-prod` — running now.

sam (eng): found backup job that uploaded ciphertext to gs://prod-backups/2025-*. will need to re-encrypt those objects.

diego (sec): comms plan: prepare CSM/legal template, vendor notification, and a short external blurb if required. prioritize internal timeline. i'll start drafting.
lina (cloud): vault ops: can we enable an audit device that forwards to splunk with immediate flush and 365d retention for incident analysis?
vault-bot: action queued: enable-audit splunk://splunk-ingest/  (executor: vault-admin) at 2026-03-22T09:30Z
lina (cloud): one more: add an automated scanner to detect any plaintext or wrapped-ciphertext patterns in public paste sites (heuristic). create a rule in SecOps.
harper (sre): I'll run a credential-bleed scan across repos and backups using regex: `'(?:vault:transit:[A-Za-z0-9+/=]+|-----BEGIN KMS CIPHERTEXT-----)'` and produce hits.

sam (eng): running scan now, will open PRs to remove any checked-in blobs. also creating tickets to re-encrypt backups.
diego (sec): decision: escalate to incident response channel, notify oncall, runbook activation. target containment within 2 hours; full rotation within 24h.

harper (sre): noted. putting steps into the incident-runbook doc and assigning owners.
lina (cloud): done the allowlist rollback. deploying canary policy now.

kms-watchdog: action: revoke service account binding for partner:thirdparty-sync@partner-project at 2026-03-22T09:20:12Z

sam (eng): PR created to remove legacy backup key reference (link)
diego (sec): thanks team. keep thread updated. will schedule 30m postmortem after rotation. :lock:
